title: Singularities of orbit closures in loop spaces of symmetric varieties II: twisted cases
summary: We study the singularities of orbit closures in loop symmetric varieties, extending our previous work https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.20006 to the twisted setting. We prove that the IC complexes of orbit closures are pointwise pure and satisfy a parity-vanishing property. We apply these geometric results to the study of twisted affine Lusztig--Vogan modules, establishing foundational results, including positivity properties of the twisted affine Kazhdan--Lusztig--Vogan polynomials. Along the way, we construct conical symplectic transversal slices in loop symmetric spaces. We provide applications…
